gloss: to go out to meet, to greet, to welcome

definitions.gloss: to go out to meet, to greet
definitions.explanation: To go to a place to meet and welcome someone who is arriving.
To greet someone upon their arrival.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}で{母|はは}を{出迎|でむか}えた。
examples.english: I met my mother at the station.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}に{友人|ゆうじん}を{出迎|でむか}えに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the airport to meet my friend.

examples.japanese: {笑顔|えがお}で{子|こ}どもたちを{出迎|でむか}えに{玄関|げんかん}まで{出|で}た。
examples.english: I went out to the entrance to greet the children with a smile.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{毎日|まいにち}、{夫|おっと}を{駅|えき}まで{出迎|でむか}えに{行|い}っている。
examples.english: She goes to the station every day to meet her husband.

examples.japanese: {久|ひさ}しぶりに{帰|かえ}ってきた{息子|むすこ}を、{家族|かぞく}{全員|ぜんいん}が{出迎|でむか}えに{出|で}た。
examples.english: The whole family went out to meet their son, who had come home after a long time.

examples.japanese: {玄関|げんかん}で{お客|おきゃく}さんを{出迎|でむか}えた。
examples.english: I welcomed the guest at the entrance.

examples.japanese: ホテルの{人|ひと}が{出迎|でむか}えてくれた。
examples.english: A hotel staff member came out to welcome us.

examples.japanese: {大勢|おおぜい}のファンが{選手|せんしゅ}たちを{出迎|でむか}えた。
examples.english: A large crowd of fans welcomed the players.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}は{自|みずか}ら{空港|くうこう}まで{海外|かいがい}からの{来賓|らいひん}を{出迎|でむか}えに{行|い}った。
examples.english: The company president personally went to the airport to welcome the guests from overseas.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{年|とし}を{出迎|でむか}えるために、{家族|かぞく}みんなで{準備|じゅんび}をした。
examples.english: The whole family made preparations to welcome the new year.

notes:
{出迎|でむか}える is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) meaning to go out to meet and welcome someone.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {出|で}る (to go out) + {迎|むか}える (to greet) → to go out to greet

TRANSITIVITY:
- {出迎|でむか}える ({他動詞|たどうし}): to go out to meet someone
- Opposite: {見送|みおく}る (to see off)

ASPECT (ている):
{出迎|でむか}えている indicates waiting to greet someone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {空港|くうこう}に{出迎|でむか}えに{行|い}く (go to the airport to meet)
- {駅|えき}まで{出迎|でむか}える (meet at the station)
- {笑顔|えがお}で{出迎|でむか}える (greet with a smile)

RELATED NOUN:
- {出迎|でむか}え: greeting, reception; {出迎|でむか}えに{行|い}く = go to meet

OPPOSITE:
- {見送|みおく}る: to see off (when someone is leaving)

[Register: Neutral to Polite]
